theme: Light mode prioritized (with dark mode toggle support). ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Authority, Clarity, Truth). It evokes a modern SaaS BI tool feeling - stark, clean, highly auditable, focusing heavily on data hierarchy.

rules: H1 (Hero/Main Heading): text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl - tracking-tight, font-black.
H2 (Section Heading): text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl - tracking-tight, font-bold.
Line Height: leading-none for headings, leading-relaxed for body.
DO NOT center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Never use pure #000000. Tint neutral greys slightly.
Ensure text meets APCA standards against backgrounds.
ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover.
No generic full-screen gradients. Use solid colors and 1px sharp borders.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Container with border-collapse style layout. Items with subtle borders on right and bottom of every grid item.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E5E5E5. No soft shadows on cards. Flat, dense, rectangular. Use sharp edges or max 4px border-radius.
visual_enhancers.effects: Use Glassmorphism (Crystal variant) ONLY for sticky headers/navs: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px delicate inner stroke. Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for headers.

components.buttons: Sharp edges, flat design, high contrast. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow. Use lucide-react icons.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Dense and compact spacing.
components.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn if available). Color-blind friendly palettes using the defined accents (Brand Blue for base metrics, Signal Red for churn).
components.tables: Dense rows, clear typography. Use mono font for numbers. Striped or 1px bottom border per row.
components.forms: Shadcn form components. Strict grid alignment.
components.toast: Use Sonner for notifications (e.g., CSV upload success, prediction complete).
components.badges: Sharp rectangles or slight rounding. High contrast background/text depending on risk level.

grids_layouts.spacing_scale: p-1, p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).
grids_layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children.
grids_layouts.alignment: Mobile-first responsive. Left-align paragraphs, labels, inputs, and dense content.

rules: Micro-animations on hover states for interactive elements.
Transition specific properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform). NO 'transition-all'.
Staggered entrance animations for dashboard widgets using Framer Motion.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='predict-churn-button').
Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text.
Focus states must have HIGHER contrast.

images.description: Abstract blue geometric data visualization lines
images.category: About Page Hero Background (Use with low opacity or overlay)

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building 'ChurnSense', a Customer Churn Prediction dashboard based on IBM Telco dataset.
Implement 5 pages/views: EDA Dashboard, Model Performance, Single Predict, Batch Predict (CSV), About.
Do NOT add an 'Emergent' badge. Do include 'Built by Atharva Kshirsagar' in the footer.
Use Shadcn UI components heavily but customize them to remove the 'Vercel-look' (make borders 1px sharp, remove soft shadows, use high contrast).
Create a clean sidebar or topbar navigation. Ensure navigation links are visible on desktop (no hamburger menu on desktop).
For charts, utilize Recharts. Prioritize KPI widgets at the top left.
For the 'Predict' form, use Shadcn form inputs.
Do NOT center align the main App container. Left align content for readability.
Do NOT use 'transition: all' in CSS. Target specific properties.
Include empty-state CTAs or graceful fallbacks for the CSV batch predict before upload.
Ensure to generate .js files instead of .tsx, as per environment constraints.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Create depth through layered design elements (borders, grid layouts) rather than soft shadows.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Add micro-animations for interactions (hover, click, focus). Static = dead.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use lucide-react.
NEVER use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
